description: This file contains unit tests for a set of plugin setup wizard proxy functions related to channel setup, including createDelegatedResolveConfigured, createDelegatedPrepare, createDelegatedFinalize, and proxy creation functions. The tests verify forwarding logic, fallback behaviors, and delegation handling within the setup wizard system.

methods.name: createDelegatedResolveConfigured
methods.description: Creates a function that delegates the resolveConfigured logic to the loaded wizard, forwarding parameters and returning its result.

methods.name: createDelegatedPrepare
methods.description: Creates a function that delegates the prepare step to the loaded wizard if it implements the prepare method.

methods.name: createDelegatedFinalize
methods.description: Creates a function that delegates the finalize step to the loaded wizard if it implements the finalize method.

methods.name: createAllowlistSetupWizardProxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy implementation for setup wizard allowing fallback behaviors when delegated components are absent.

methods.name: createDelegatedSetupWizardProxy
methods.description: Builds a setup wizard proxy with delegated status, prepare, and finalize methods based on provided configuration.
